sections.title: `repName` linear scan inside render loops
Sequential awaits in `Routing.tsx:saveRoute`
sections.content:
```tsx
// ❌ Two round-trips in series
const { data: repData } = await supabase.from('reps').select('id').eq('user_id', user?.id).single()
await supabase.from('routes').insert({ rep_id: repData?.id ?? null, ... })
```
The rep lookup should be cached at component mount (it never changes during a session), not re-fetched on every save.

`filtered` stores in `DispensaryMap.tsx` — recomputed every render
`AmbientBackground.tsx` — new style objects every render
No cross-navigation data cache
`CalcResult` in `Calculator.tsx` — pure computation, no memoization
`setTimeout` without cleanup in `Routing.tsx`
CSS animations in `AmbientBackground` run unconditionally
sections.content:
The three `animation` blobs run GPU compositing indefinitely, even on pages with no background visible behind a modal. If `AmbientBackground` is inside `Layout`, this is fine; if it's also in `Login`, you have two instances running simultaneously. Verify they're not double-mounted.

---

sections.title: `byStage` makes 4 passes over `leads` array
sections.content: Already shown above — the `STAGES.reduce` calls `leads.filter()` once per stage. A single `for...of` pass is 4× more efficient.

sections.title: `BATCH_EXPIRES` / `BATCH_CODE` duplicated across files
sections.content: `Dashboard.tsx` and `Inventory.tsx` both hardcode the same constants. Not a runtime perf issue, but a maintenance hazard — extract to `src/lib/constants.ts`.

sections.title: `daysUntil` called with a string literal on every render in `Inventory.tsx`
Priority Order
sections.content:
| Issue | Impact | Effort |
|---|---|---|
| `repName` O(n) scan in render | Medium (scales with store count) | Low |
| `byStage` multi-pass filter | Low-Medium | Low |
| `setTimeout` without cleanup | High (silent bug) | Low |
| `filtered` stores without `useMemo` | Low | Low |
| Shared `reps` cache | Medium (network RTTs) | Medium |
| `CalcResult` memo | Low (local calc) | Low |

The `setTimeout` cleanup is the only actual bug — the rest are optimizations.

codeBlocks.code:
// ❌ Both files — linear scan per item
const repName = (id: string | null) => reps.find(r => r.id === id)?.name ?? '—'

// ❌ Runs on every render
const filtered = filterRegion ? stores.filter(s => s.region === filterRegion) : stores

// ❌ Inline objects create new references, forcing reconciliation
style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(...)', top: '-10%', left: '-5%', animation: 'drift1 18s...' }}

// ✅ Memoize the component since all inputs are primitives
export const CalcResult = memo(function CalcResult({ units, tier, rate, hasBonus, storeCount }) { ... })

// ❌ New Date parse on every render
const daysLeft = daysUntil(BATCH_EXPIRES)

// ✅ Stable since BATCH_EXPIRES is a constant
const daysLeft = useMemo(() => daysUntil(BATCH_EXPIRES), [])
